evidence.text: Topics. list growth & pop-up architecture / capturing 8–12% of traffic using large, mobile-optimized pop-ups (75%+ screen coverage) with a single input field, clear value proposition (e.g., dollars off for AOV >$100), 4–12 second time delay, and minimal copy; core lifecycle flows / building automated sequences that drive roughly 50% of total email revenue, specifically: Welcome (8 emails focusing on brand mission, USPS, and founder outreach), Site Abandon (1 email, best sellers), Browse Abandon (5 emails, dynamically pulling viewed items), and Winback (3 emails deployed at 2x the average order interval); Cart Abandonment vs. Checkout Abandonment / distinguishing between "Added to Cart" (custom JavaScript snippet required in Shopify) and "Checkout Started" (native integration), ensuring separate flows so top-of-funnel cart abandoners are not dropped; non-discount campaign engine / sending 3–4 non-promotional campaigns per week focused on a single "microtopic" (one feature, one benefit, or one FAQ) to build authority, stay top-of-mind, and preserve profit margins; flow optimization loop / using high-frequency email campaigns as an instant testing ground and cycling winning campaign angles directly into automated flows; email copywriting / writing skimmable, punchy, and concise copy (under two mobile scrolls) that uses bold headers and infographics (timelines, checklists, comparison tables) rather than dense text blocks; deliverability recovery protocol / executing a 6-week rehabilitation plan for sender reputations below 40% open rates by temporarily shutting non-essential flows and strictly sending 3x weekly to a 14-day engaged segment before gradually expanding to 30, 60, and 90 days; segmentation & suppression / maintaining list health by segmenting by engagement (30/60/90-day active), store behavior (VIPs, browse without purchase), and suppressing profiles with zero opens in 180 days or any hard bounce.
